title: The run-state pin's CAS table has no row for the attempt handle-completion write t5p relies on
body: contracts/ticfac-run-state.json says 'each record kind gets exactly one of them' and its modes table lists the checkpoint as the only sha_guarded_update record — its TS reader test pins that ('makes the checkpoint the only record that is ever updated'). t5p adds a SHA-guarded, once-per-dispatch completion of the attempt record's job_handle, which the SAME pinned bundle's job-protocol.json start rule requires ('then record the returned handle. A handle that was never persisted is a job nobody can find after a restart') and the attempt schema's own job_handle comment describes ('The JobHandle returned by the executor's start'). The bundle should be re-cut with a row/wording for the attempt handle completion (create-if-absent for the dispatch, one sha-guarded completion after start answers), so the Go and TS readers agree about what writes an attempt record can take — today the Go store has no completion path because local markers never needed one, and a one-sided behaviour change is exactly what the bundle exists to catch.
